title: TheAgentCompany: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Consequential Real World Tasks
authors_zh: Frank (Fangzheng) Xu, Yufan Song, Boxuan Li, Yuxuan Tang, Kritanjali Jain, Mengxue Bao, Zora Wang, Xuhui Zhou, Zhitong Guo, Murong Cao, Mingyang Yang, Hao Yang Lu, Amaad Martin, Zhe Su, Leander Maben, Raj Mehta, Wayne Chi, Lawrence Jang, Yiqing Xie, Shuyan Zhou, Graham Neubig
paper_type_zh: 工作场景智能体评测环境与评测轨迹发布
best_for_zh: 研究长程工具调用智能体、环境反馈、轨迹评测与 benchmark 审计的读者
one_line: TheAgentCompany pairs 175 simulated-company tasks with mixed checkpoint evaluators and releases model-generated results, screenshots, and full evaluation trajectories.
TheAgentCompany 将 175 个模拟公司任务、混合 checkpoint evaluator 与模型生成的结果、截图和完整评测轨迹连接起来，但轨迹日志许可、不可变环境版本、split、去污染、逐条 lineage、judge 校准和隐私同意仍未确认。
why: It makes the full agent-data loop inspectable—prompt, environment state, action history, checkpoint feedback, and terminal outcome—while also exposing version drift, judge dependence, and release-rights gaps that matter before trajectories are reused.
inclusion_reason: TheAgentCompany exposes an unusually complete environment-feedback boundary for long-horizon workplace agents: 175 task prompts, a self-hosted multi-service state space, checkpoint evaluators, terminal scores, and official successful/failed episode logs.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary text for this Card is the archival NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks paper; the arXiv record establishes that the work first appeared on 2024-12-18, which is why the stable id and metadata year remain 2024. The official project, benchmark repository, release 1.0.0, environment-backup repository, and experiments repository provide the executable and record-level evidence. This date distinction matters because the paper and baselines changed between arXiv v1 and the archival version.

TheAgentCompany asks whether a general computer-using agent can complete consequential, multi-step workplace tasks whose state is distributed across code, files, terminal processes, web applications, and social interaction. Static question-answer or single-turn tool benchmarks do not expose this whole feedback boundary. Here, the agent works inside a Dockerized Linux workspace and a self-hosted intranet containing GitLab, ownCloud, Plane, and RocketChat; 41 tasks additionally involve Sotopia-based simulated colleagues.

The benchmark release contains 175 manually curated tasks. A task record includes an English intent in task.md, weighted checkpoints in checkpoints.md, a task-specific evaluator, initialization/finalization logic, dependencies, and container configuration. An evaluated episode binds the task id to ordered observations, actions, environment transitions and communication events, screenshots, evaluator/checkpoint outcomes, and a terminal result. Official experiment runs publish per-task result JSON, per-step screenshots, and compressed trajectory JSON. These trajectories were produced by evaluated models and harnesses; they are not human demonstrations or an authored training-trace corpus.

This makes the work directly relevant to environment_agent_trajectory_data: the environment is part of the verifier, feedback attaches to checkpoints and the full episode, and official successful, partial, and zero-score logs make failure behavior inspectable. The Card does not treat the public logs as training data, does not infer a train/dev/test split, and does not generalize benchmark scores into claims about workplace automation. L4-depth coverage is supported for the task object, environment, evaluation contract, construction process, released run shape, and versioned evidence; experiment-log rights, immutable run/image manifests, decontamination, task-level lineage, judge calibration, and privacy/consent remain unresolved.

本卡片以 NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track 的正式论文为主要文本；arXiv 记录显示论文在 2024 年 12 月 18 日首次公开，因此稳定 id 与元数据年份继续使用 2024。官方项目页、benchmark 仓库、1.0.0 release、环境备份仓库与 experiments 仓库提供可执行和记录级证据。必须区分这两个日期，因为论文内容与 baseline 在 arXiv v1 到正式版本之间发生了变化。

TheAgentCompany 研究通用计算机使用智能体能否完成具有实际后果的多步工作任务，其中状态分散在代码、文件、终端进程、Web 应用与社交交互中。静态问答或单轮工具 benchmark 无法暴露这条完整反馈边界。智能体在 Docker 化 Linux workspace 和自托管 intranet 中工作，后者包含 GitLab、ownCloud、Plane 与 RocketChat；其中 41 个任务还使用基于 Sotopia 的模拟同事。

benchmark release 包含 175 个经人工整理的任务。每条任务记录包含 task.md 中的英文意图、checkpoints.md 中的加权 checkpoint、任务特定 evaluator、初始化/结束逻辑、依赖与 container 配置。一次评测 episode 将 task id 与有序 observation、action、环境转移和通信事件、截图、evaluator/checkpoint 结果及终态绑定起来。官方 experiment run 发布逐任务 result JSON、逐步截图和压缩 trajectory JSON。这些轨迹由被评测模型与 harness 生成，不是人工示范，也不是经作者编写的训练轨迹语料。

因此该工作直接属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data：环境本身构成 verifier 的一部分，反馈附着于 checkpoint 和完整 episode，官方成功、部分得分与零分日志使失败行为可审计。本卡片不把公开日志称为训练数据，不推断 train/dev/test split，也不把 benchmark 分数外推为工作自动化结论。当前证据足以按 L4 深度描述任务对象、环境、评测契约、构造流程、发布 run 结构与版本化结果；experiment-log 权利、不可变 run/image manifest、去污染、任务级 lineage、judge 校准及隐私/同意仍未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is: TheAgentCompany packages an imagined software company as a versioned, multi-service agent environment in which manually authored workplace tasks are evaluated by weighted checkpoints, then releases model-specific results, screenshots, and full evaluation trajectories.

The core mechanism has three coupled objects. First, each task specifies an agent-visible intent plus hidden evaluation and environment setup. Second, the episode exposes browser/UI, terminal, code/workspace, file, and RocketChat observations while recording the agent's actions and transitions. Third, a mixed feedback contract maps the resulting state or trajectory to weighted checkpoint outcomes. Most evaluators are deterministic Python checks over final/intermediate state or trajectory; 51 of 175 tasks (29%) use an LLM judge for complex or unstructured deliverables, with rubrics or reference outputs. Full success requires every checkpoint to pass, while weighted checkpoint completion supplies a partial score and the benchmark also reports a binary full-completion indicator.

The feedback can observe evaluator-visible environment state, selected trajectory events, and outputs captured by task-specific predicates. It cannot certify untested semantic quality, intent compliance beyond those predicates, or the stability and calibration of the LLM judge. Runtime evaluator encryption discourages direct peeking, but published evaluator sources and public task prompts still permit benchmark-specific optimization and future contamination. State/action-level supervision in the metadata therefore means checkpoint-sensitive process evidence; it does not mean the release provides a calibrated reward after every reasoning step.

Relative to static completion benchmarks, the important change is that success depends on coordinated state changes across several services and, for some tasks, interaction with simulated colleagues. Relative to adjacent environment benchmarks such as tau2-bench-2025 and osworld-mcp-2025, this Card's distinguishing evidence is the self-hosted company substrate, manually implemented weighted checkpoints, and official run directories retaining complete model/harness-specific episodes. Those related works remain useful comparison points, but the present evidence does not establish that TheAgentCompany's judge is more accurate or its tasks more representative.

The direction signal for reasoning-data research is the explicit linkage task prompt -> environment state -> action history -> checkpoint feedback -> terminal outcome. That linkage supports episode replay and verifier audit. It does not by itself justify SFT, preference learning, reward-model training, process supervision, or agent RL from the released logs; the paper-supported use is evaluation only.

一句话贡献是：TheAgentCompany 把一个虚构软件公司封装为有版本的多服务智能体环境，用加权 checkpoint 评测人工编写的工作任务，并发布按模型区分的结果、截图与完整评测轨迹。

核心机制连接三类对象。第一，每个任务同时定义智能体可见意图、隐藏评测逻辑与环境 setup。第二，episode 暴露 browser/UI、terminal、code/workspace、文件及 RocketChat observation，并记录智能体 action 与环境转移。第三，混合反馈契约把所得状态或轨迹映射为加权 checkpoint 结果。多数 evaluator 是检查最终/中间状态或轨迹的确定性 Python 程序；175 个任务中有 51 个（29%）对复杂或非结构化交付物使用带 rubric 或 reference output 的 LLM judge。全部 checkpoint 通过才算 full success；加权 checkpoint 完成度给出 partial score，同时 benchmark 还报告二值 full-completion 指标。

该反馈能观察 evaluator 可见的环境状态、选定轨迹事件，以及由任务特定 predicate 捕获的输出；它不能认证测试未覆盖的语义质量、predicate 之外的意图遵从，也不能保证 LLM judge 的稳定性与校准。运行时 evaluator 加密可以阻止直接偷看，但公开的 evaluator 源码与 task prompt 仍允许 benchmark-specific 优化并带来未来污染。因此元数据中的 state/action-level supervision 指 checkpoint 敏感的过程证据，不表示发布在每个推理步骤后都提供经校准 reward。

相对静态 completion benchmark，关键变化是成功依赖多个服务间协调的状态修改，部分任务还要求与模拟同事交互。相对 tau2-bench-2025 与 osworld-mcp-2025 等相邻环境 benchmark，本卡片能确认的区分点是自托管公司 substrate、人工实现的加权 checkpoint，以及保留完整模型/harness 特定 episode 的官方 run 目录。这些工作仍是有用对照，但现有证据不能证明 TheAgentCompany 的 judge 更准确或任务更具代表性。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向信号是明确连接 task prompt -> environment state -> action history -> checkpoint feedback -> terminal outcome。这条链支持 episode replay 与 verifier audit，但不能单凭日志存在就支持 SFT、preference learning、reward-model training、process supervision 或 agent RL；论文证据支持的用途仅为 evaluation。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and task construction. The authors start from O*NET 29.1 job-task lists and U.S. labor statistics for occupational coverage, then combine those sources with coauthor domain experience and LLM brainstorming. The brainstorming model, prompts, sampling parameters, rejection rate, and random seeds are not disclosed. 20 CS students, software engineers, and project managers worked for two months, totaling about 3,000 person-hours; some tasks required more than ten hours. Each accepted task is manually implemented as an intent, weighted checkpoints, evaluator, initialization/finalization logic, dependencies, and a container image. Quality control includes screenshot evidence, evaluator tests, lead-author code review, final manual double-checking, and independent checkpoint-importance review, but per-task review logs are not released.

Environment and rollout. A run resets the task's Dockerized Linux workspace and self-hosted GitLab, ownCloud, Plane, and RocketChat services. The agent receives only the English task instruction from task.md, then uses browser, terminal, code/files, and communication actions. 41 tasks include simulated colleagues represented with Sotopia profiles; the paper baselines use Claude-3-5-Sonnet-20241022 for those NPCs. Main experiments use OpenHands CodeAct + Browsing, with versions 0.14.2 and 0.28.1 appearing across paper versions; an OWL RolePlay comparison is also reported. The archival paper evaluates twelve model backbones. A standard repeated-seed protocol, decoding temperature, and one uniform step/token budget across configurations are unknown.

Verification and output. Task-specific Python evaluators inspect final/intermediate environment state or selected trajectory information. For 51 tasks, LLM-based evaluation handles complex or unstructured outputs, using Claude-3-5-Sonnet-20241022 in the paper experiments; authors report review/testing by 3–5 contributors and CI, but release no independent calibration corpus. Evaluators produce checkpoint outcomes and weighted points. Full completion requires all checkpoints; partial score aggregates checkpoint credit and adds the documented full-completion bonus. Agent exit or budget exhaustion terminates the episode without implying success.

Release path. Each official experiment run occupies a named subdirectory of evaluation/1.0.0/. The inspected 2024-12-17 OpenHands 0.14.2 + Claude-3.5-Sonnet run contains a run README, per-task result JSON, per-step screenshots, and compressed trajectory JSON for successful, partial, and zero-score tasks. Leaderboard submission instructions require results, trajectories, screenshots, and a README, but completeness of every historical third-party run has not been verified. There is no reported quality filter selecting trajectories for training.

Use and reproducibility boundary. The pipeline output is a benchmark evaluation episode plus checkpoint and terminal feedback, not a training example selected by a teacher. Supported use is evaluation only. Reproduction should pin benchmark release 1.0.0, paper version, main-code commit, experiment run path/commit, task images, service backups, OpenHands version, model endpoints, NPC model, and judge model. Immutable image digests and full run manifests are not provided in the accepted evidence. No train/validation/test split or decontamination protocol is disclosed.

输入与任务构造。 作者先用 O*NET 29.1 job-task list 与美国劳动力统计确定职业覆盖，再结合合作者领域经验与 LLM brainstorming 形成具体任务。brainstorming 模型、prompt、采样参数、拒绝率与随机种子均未披露。20 名计算机专业学生、软件工程师和项目经理工作两个月，合计约 3,000 person-hours；部分任务构造超过十小时。每个入选任务都被人工实现为意图、加权 checkpoint、evaluator、初始化/结束逻辑、依赖与 container image。质量控制包括截图证据、evaluator 测试、第一作者代码审查、最终人工 double-check 和独立 checkpoint 重要性评审，但逐任务 review log 未发布。

环境与 rollout。 一次 run 会重置任务的 Docker 化 Linux workspace 及自托管 GitLab、ownCloud、Plane 和 RocketChat 服务。智能体只接收 task.md 中的英文任务说明，随后通过 browser、terminal、code/files 与通信 action 工作。41 个任务包含以 Sotopia profile 表示的模拟同事；论文 baseline 使用 Claude-3-5-Sonnet-20241022 作为这些 NPC。主要实验采用 OpenHands CodeAct + Browsing，不同论文版本分别出现 0.14.2 与 0.28.1，并报告 OWL RolePlay 对照。正式论文评测十二种模型 backbone。标准重复 seed 协议、decoding temperature 及跨配置统一的 step/token budget 均为 unknown。

验证与输出。 任务特定 Python evaluator 检查最终/中间环境状态或选定轨迹信息。51 个任务对复杂或非结构化输出使用 LLM-based evaluation，论文实验采用 Claude-3-5-Sonnet-20241022；作者报告 evaluator 经 3–5 名贡献者和 CI 审查/测试，但没有发布独立校准语料。evaluator 产生 checkpoint 结果与加权分。全部 checkpoint 通过才算 full completion；partial score 聚合 checkpoint 得分并加入论文定义的 full-completion bonus。智能体主动退出或 budget 耗尽会结束 episode，但不等于成功。

发布路径。 每个官方 experiment run 都位于 evaluation/1.0.0/ 下一个有名称的子目录。已检查的 2024-12-17 OpenHands 0.14.2 + Claude-3.5-Sonnet run 包含 run README、逐任务 result JSON、逐步截图和压缩 trajectory JSON，并保留成功、部分得分与零分任务。leaderboard 提交说明要求 results、trajectories、screenshots 与 README，但尚未逐个核验所有历史第三方 run 的完整性。论文没有报告为训练用途筛选轨迹的质量 filter。

用途与复现边界。 pipeline 输出是带 checkpoint 和终态反馈的 benchmark evaluation episode，不是经 teacher 选择的训练样本。证据支持的用途仅为 evaluation。复现时应固定 benchmark release 1.0.0、论文版本、主代码 commit、experiment run path/commit、task image、service backup、OpenHands 版本、模型 endpoint、NPC model 与 judge model。已接受证据没有提供不可变 image digest 或完整 run manifest；train/validation/test split 与去污染协议也未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The benchmark evidence is anchored to version 1.0.0 and 175 tasks. The archival appendix reports 69 software-engineering, 28 project-management, 14 data-science, 15 administrative, 29 human-resources, 12 finance, and 8 other tasks; these counts sum to 175. The construction evidence is author-reported: 20 contributors worked for two months, about 3,000 person-hours, and some tasks took more than ten hours. The authors also report evaluator tests, screenshot evidence, code review, manual double-checks, and independent checkpoint-importance review. These procedures document a construction effort, but the absence of released per-task review logs prevents a record-level quality audit.

For evaluator composition, 51 tasks (29%) involve LLM evaluation; the remainder are primarily deterministic state/trajectory checks. Paper baselines use Claude-3-5-Sonnet-20241022 for LLM evaluators and simulated colleagues. The archival paper says assessors were reviewed and tested by 3–5 contributors plus CI. This supports the existence of a mixed verification contract, not an estimate of judge error or inter-run variance, because no independent judge-calibration corpus is released.

The key performance numbers must be versioned rather than read as one improvement curve. The official 2024-12-17 run with OpenHands 0.14.2 and Claude-3.5-Sonnet reports 42/175 full successes (24.0%), a 34.4% partial score, 29.17 average steps, and $6.34 average cost per task. The archival NeurIPS paper reports Gemini 2.5 Pro with OpenHands 0.28.1 at 30.3% full success and 39.3% partial score, with 27.2 average steps and $4.2 average cost per task. The harness version, model, and paper version changed; therefore 24.0% to 30.3% is baseline/version drift, not a controlled ablation and not evidence that the dataset itself improved.

The release evidence is stronger than a paper-only benchmark: the inspected official baseline directory contains results and trajectories for successful, partial, and zero-score tasks, plus per-step screenshots. The public submission contract asks for the same artifact classes. This supports failure analysis for the inspected run, but it does not prove that every historical third-party run is complete or consistently licensed.

The paper's error analysis includes premature completion in social interaction, browsing/UI failure, and shortcuts that satisfy an evaluator-visible state without satisfying the intended task, such as renaming a user. These are observed baseline failures and concrete warnings about environment/evaluator brittleness; they are not exhaustive failure rates. Human feasibility and evaluator checks were performed, but no human performance baseline was collected because tasks can take from roughly ten minutes to several hours. The authors also caution that the task set is not exhaustive or representative enough for broad job-automation claims. None of these benchmark results demonstrates training-data quality or benefit from training on the released logs.

benchmark 证据绑定 version 1.0.0 与 175 个任务。正式论文附录报告 69 个软件工程、28 个项目管理、14 个数据科学、15 个行政、29 个人力资源、12 个金融和 8 个其他任务，合计 175 个。构造投入来自作者报告：20 名贡献者工作两个月，约 3,000 person-hours，部分任务超过十小时。作者还报告 evaluator 测试、截图证据、代码审查、人工 double-check 与独立 checkpoint 重要性评审。这些流程说明了构造投入，但未发布逐任务 review log，因此不能执行记录级质量审计。

在 evaluator 构成上，51 个任务（29%）涉及 LLM evaluation，其余主要使用确定性状态/轨迹检查。论文 baseline 采用 Claude-3-5-Sonnet-20241022 作为 LLM evaluator 与模拟同事模型。正式论文称 assessor 经 3–5 名贡献者及 CI 审查和测试。这能证明混合 verification contract 存在，但无法估计 judge 误差或跨 run 方差，因为没有发布独立 judge-calibration corpus。

关键性能数字必须按版本读取，不能解释成一条统一提升曲线。官方 2024-12-17 run 使用 OpenHands 0.14.2 与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet，报告 42/175 个 full success（24.0%）、34.4% partial score、平均 29.17 steps 和每任务 $6.34 成本。NeurIPS 正式论文中，Gemini 2.5 Pro 配合 OpenHands 0.28.1 达到 30.3% full success 与 39.3% partial score，平均 27.2 steps、每任务 $4.2。harness 版本、模型和论文版本都已变化，因此 24.0% 到 30.3% 是 baseline/version drift，不是受控消融，也不能证明数据集本身变好。

发布证据强于仅有论文的 benchmark：已检查的官方 baseline 目录同时包含成功、部分得分与零分任务的 result 和 trajectory，并带逐步截图；公开 submission contract 也要求相同 artifact 类别。这支持对已检查 run 开展失败分析，但不能证明所有历史第三方 run 都完整或采用一致许可证。

论文 error analysis 给出社交交互中过早结束、浏览/UI 失败，以及只满足 evaluator 可见状态而没有满足真实任务意图的 shortcut，例如重命名某个 user。这些是已观察 baseline 失败，也是环境/evaluator 脆弱性的具体警告，不是穷尽性失败率。作者进行过 human feasibility 与 evaluator 检查，但任务可能耗时约十分钟到数小时，因此没有收集人类性能 baseline。作者还强调任务集合不足以支撑广泛 job-automation 结论。上述 benchmark 结果都不能证明训练数据质量，也不能证明在发布日志上训练会带来收益。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline for many agent evaluations is a prompt paired with a narrow tool surface and a terminal pass/fail check. TheAgentCompany changes the evaluation object into a long-horizon workplace episode spanning several self-hosted services, a local code/file/terminal workspace, and model-mediated colleagues. Its record joins an agent-visible intent, hidden weighted checkpoints, task-specific evaluators, state/action history, screenshots, partial checkpoint outcomes, and terminal full completion.

The important data contribution is not merely the 175-task count. It is the release boundary: benchmark release 1.0.0 provides task and environment implementations, while the official experiments repository stores model/harness-specific result JSON, screenshots, and compressed trajectories under versioned run paths. The inspected baseline retains successful, partial, and zero-score episodes, enabling analysis of both completion and failure rather than exposing only leaderboard aggregates. This is why data_release is justified even though the records are evaluation logs rather than a training dataset.

The feedback contribution is the use of weighted checkpoints over heterogeneous workplace state. Deterministic Python checks are combined with LLM judging for outputs that are difficult to reduce to exact predicates. This makes the verifier/environment interface visible enough to study state-sensitive credit and terminal success. It also exposes a key research problem: judge behavior, evaluator shortcuts, NPC behavior, and service state can all become part of the measured outcome.

The work does not individually introduce Docker sandboxes, browser/terminal agents, self-hosted collaboration software, checkpoint scoring, LLM-as-judge, role-play agents, or trajectory logging. Much of the contribution is careful benchmark construction and systems integration across those components. The task source also mixes established occupational lists, domain experience, and undisclosed LLM brainstorming rather than presenting a fully reproducible task-generation algorithm.

For reasoning-data research, the directional novelty is that prompts, environment transitions, actions, checkpoint feedback, and terminal results are available as one auditable episode object. Reuse checks remain essential: pin paper and run versions, establish experiment-log rights, audit evaluator and judge calibration, reconstruct task-level source lineage, measure contamination, verify failure retention, and review privacy/consent. Performance scale or venue acceptance is not a data-quality signal.

许多 agent evaluation 的先前基线是 prompt 加狭窄 tool surface 与终态 pass/fail 检查。TheAgentCompany 把评测对象改成跨多个自托管服务、本地代码/文件/终端 workspace 与模型驱动同事的长程工作 episode。每条记录连接智能体可见意图、隐藏加权 checkpoint、任务特定 evaluator、state/action history、截图、部分 checkpoint 结果和终态 full completion。

关键数据贡献不只是 175 个任务的数量，而是发布边界：benchmark release 1.0.0 提供任务与环境实现，官方 experiments 仓库则在有版本的 run path 下保存模型/harness 特定 result JSON、截图与压缩 trajectory。已检查的 baseline 同时保留成功、部分得分与零分 episode，因此可以分析完成和失败，而非只暴露 leaderboard aggregate。也正因为如此，即使这些记录是评测日志而不是训练数据集，data_release 仍有证据支持。

反馈层的具体贡献是在异构工作状态上使用加权 checkpoint，并把确定性 Python 检查与针对难以精确化输出的 LLM judging 组合起来。这使 verifier/environment interface 足够可见，可以研究状态敏感 credit 与终态成功；同时也暴露关键研究问题：judge 行为、evaluator shortcut、NPC 行为与 service state 都可能成为测量结果的一部分。

该工作没有分别发明 Docker sandbox、browser/terminal agent、自托管协作软件、checkpoint scoring、LLM-as-judge、role-play agent 或 trajectory logging。贡献中相当部分来自对这些组件的 benchmark 构造与系统整合。任务来源也混合既有职业列表、领域经验与未披露的 LLM brainstorming，而不是一套完全可复现的任务生成算法。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向性新意在于把 prompt、环境转移、action、checkpoint feedback 和 terminal result 作为一个可审计 episode 对象提供。复用前仍必须固定论文与 run 版本、确认 experiment-log 权利、审计 evaluator 与 judge 校准、重建任务级 source lineage、测量污染、核验失败保留并审查隐私/同意。性能规模或 venue acceptance 不是数据质量信号。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The 175 tasks form one public evaluation set; no train/validation/test partition or model-pretraining/agent-development decontamination protocol is disclosed. Public task prompts and evaluator sources increase future exposure and benchmark-specific gaming risk, even though runtime evaluator code is encrypted in task images.
  • Feedback validity is bounded by task-specific predicates. Deterministic checks can reward unintended state changes or miss semantic failures, while the 51 LLM-evaluated tasks inherit judge-model variance and rubric bias. No independent judge-calibration corpus or repeated-judge variance estimate is released. The observed user-renaming shortcut illustrates verifier gaming rather than merely an agent capability failure.
  • Reproducibility depends on more than repository code: task images, service backups, OpenHands versions, browser behavior, model APIs, Claude-3-5-Sonnet-20241022 NPCs/judges, and run configuration can all drift. Release 1.0.0 and run paths are identified, but immutable container/service-image digests and complete per-run manifests are unknown.
  • The 24.0% 2024 result and 30.3% archival result use different model and OpenHands configurations. Treating this as a controlled improvement would conflate model, harness, and paper-version changes. The experiments repository is also a living leaderboard, so an unpinned “best score” is not a stable paper result.
  • The inspected 2024-12-17 baseline retains successful, partial, and zero-score trajectories, but completeness is not independently established for every historical third-party run. Missing or inconsistent failed episodes could bias downstream error analysis. There is no evidence of a selection or filtering policy designed to make these logs suitable for training.
  • The main benchmark and environment-backup repositories declare MIT, and the current arXiv manuscript is CC BY 4.0, but the official experiments repository has no confirmed license. Those licenses do not automatically cover third-party services, real-world project material, screenshots, or model outputs. Training or redistribution of trajectories is blocked pending a record-level rights review.
  • The imagined company uses mock/manual material together with “real-world software project data.” Per-record source lineage, rights, redaction, consent, deletion policy, and captured screenshot contents are unknown. Simulated colleagues do not make privacy review inapplicable because seeded source material may still concern real people or projects.
  • Task construction uses undisclosed LLM brainstorming and extensive manual labor. The model, prompt, sampling, rejection rate, and seeds are unknown; per-task review logs are unavailable. This prevents reconstruction of the source mixture and measurement of selection bias.
  • The environment covers a specific self-hosted software-company setting. Tasks are not exhaustive or representative of occupations, and no human performance baseline was collected. Generalization to other organizations, tools, languages, accessibility settings, or real workplace consequences remains unsupported; job-automation claims would exceed the evidence.
  • The release is supported for evaluation and audit, not for SFT, preference learning, reward modeling, process supervision, or agent RL. Benchmark performance does not prove that its trajectories are high-quality training data, and the paper reports no training ablation using them.

• 175 个任务构成一个公开 evaluation set；论文没有披露 train/validation/test partition，也没有针对模型预训练或 agent development 的去污染协议。虽然 task image 中的 evaluator 代码在运行时加密，公开 task prompt 与 evaluator 源码仍会增加未来暴露和 benchmark-specific gaming 风险。
  • 反馈有效性受任务特定 predicate 限制。确定性检查可能奖励非预期状态修改或漏掉语义失败；51 个 LLM-evaluated 任务还继承 judge-model 方差与 rubric bias。发布中没有独立 judge-calibration corpus 或重复 judge 方差估计。论文观察到的重命名 user shortcut 是 verifier gaming 的例子，不只是智能体能力失败。
  • 复现依赖不止仓库代码：task image、service backup、OpenHands 版本、browser 行为、模型 API、Claude-3-5-Sonnet-20241022 NPC/judge 与 run configuration 都可能漂移。release 1.0.0 和 run path 已知，但不可变 container/service-image digest 与完整逐 run manifest 为 unknown。
  • 2024 年 24.0% 结果与正式论文 30.3% 结果使用不同模型和 OpenHands 配置。把它解释为受控提升会混淆模型、harness 与论文版本变化。experiments 仓库还是持续更新的 leaderboard，因此未固定的“best score”不是稳定论文结果。
  • 已检查的 2024-12-17 baseline 保留成功、部分得分和零分 trajectory，但尚未独立确认所有历史第三方 run 的完整性。失败 episode 缺失或不一致可能使下游 error analysis 产生偏差。现有证据也没有为训练适用性设计的日志选择或过滤策略。
  • 主 benchmark 与环境备份仓库声明 MIT，当前 arXiv 手稿采用 CC BY 4.0，但官方 experiments 仓库没有已确认 license。这些许可证不会自动覆盖第三方服务、真实项目材料、截图或模型输出。在完成记录级权利审查前，trajectory 训练或再分发应视为 blocked。
  • 虚构公司环境同时使用 mock/manual material 与“real-world software project data”。逐记录 source lineage、权利、redaction、consent、删除政策与截图内容均为 unknown。模拟同事并不会让隐私审查变成不适用，因为 seeded source material 仍可能涉及真实人物或项目。
  • 任务构造使用未披露的 LLM brainstorming 与大量人工劳动。模型、prompt、sampling、拒绝率与 seed 为 unknown，逐任务 review log 也不可用，因此无法重建 source mixture 或测量 selection bias。
  • 环境覆盖特定的自托管软件公司场景。任务并不穷尽职业，也不具代表性，且没有收集人类性能 baseline。向其他组织、工具、语言、无障碍设置或真实工作后果的泛化没有证据；job-automation 结论会超出论文边界。
  • 发布证据只支持 evaluation 与 audit，不支持 SFT、preference learning、reward modeling、process supervision 或 agent RL。benchmark 性能不能证明轨迹是高质量训练数据，论文也没有报告使用这些轨迹的训练消融。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, TheAgentCompany is most useful as an evaluation and audit substrate. A researcher can bind a task prompt and reset state to the agent's action/observation sequence, per-step screenshots, checkpoint outcomes, partial score, and terminal full-success flag. This makes it possible to ask whether a failure came from planning, UI grounding, terminal/code use, cross-service coordination, social interaction, premature stopping, or a mismatch between intended and evaluator-visible success.

The mixed verifier is a concrete audit target. Deterministic evaluators can be tested by constructing adversarial state changes and checking whether checkpoint predicates accept unintended shortcuts. The 51 LLM-evaluated tasks can be rerun with repeated judge calls, alternative judge models, blinded human labels, and rubric perturbations to estimate stability and false-positive/false-negative behavior. Such studies should preserve the original predicate and run version so evaluator changes are not confused with agent changes.

The official successful, partial, and zero-score logs support failure-retention and trajectory-schema studies. Researchers can compare action length, tool switching, communication events, screenshots, and checkpoint patterns across outcomes, or build replay diagnostics that verify whether a compressed trajectory matches reported results. These are evaluation analyses. Reusing the same records for SFT, preference pairs, PRM/reward-model training, process supervision, or agent RL is not supported by the paper and is blocked by the unconfirmed experiments-repository license, missing split/decontamination, incomplete lineage, unknown privacy/consent, and judge-calibration gaps.

The benchmark is also a construction reference: occupational/task ideation, manual task implementation, checkpoint design, evaluator testing, environment packaging, simulated colleagues, and versioned run submission form a concrete recipe for creating a multi-service agent evaluation. A useful replication would log task-source lineage, brainstorming prompts, review decisions, image digests, service versions, evaluator tests, judge calibration, and rejected/failed artifacts from the outset—items the current release leaves incomplete.

Safe reuse level is evaluation and audit only, with explicit version pinning and rights review. It is suitable for comparing agents, studying environment feedback, stress-testing verifiers, and designing better release manifests. It is not presently safe to call the trajectory repository a generally licensed training corpus, and benchmark scores should not be used as evidence of either data quality or occupational automation.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，TheAgentCompany 最有价值的定位是 evaluation 与 audit substrate。研究者可以把 task prompt 和 reset state 与智能体 action/observation 序列、逐步截图、checkpoint 结果、partial score 和终态 full-success flag 绑定起来，从而判断失败更可能来自 planning、UI grounding、terminal/code 使用、跨服务协调、社交交互、过早停止，还是预期成功与 evaluator 可见成功之间的错位。

混合 verifier 本身就是具体审计对象。可以构造对抗性状态修改，检查确定性 evaluator 的 checkpoint predicate 是否接受非预期 shortcut。对 51 个 LLM-evaluated 任务，可以重复 judge 调用、替换 judge model、加入盲评人类标签并扰动 rubric，以估计稳定性、false positive 与 false negative。此类研究应保留原始 predicate 与 run 版本，避免把 evaluator 变化误认为 agent 变化。

官方成功、部分得分与零分日志支持 failure-retention 与 trajectory-schema 研究。研究者可以比较不同结果下的 action length、tool switching、communication event、截图与 checkpoint pattern，也可以构建 replay diagnostic，核对压缩 trajectory 是否与报告结果一致。这些都属于 evaluation analysis。把相同记录用于 SFT、preference pair、PRM/reward-model training、process supervision 或 agent RL 没有论文支持，并受到 experiments 仓库 license 未确认、split/去污染缺失、lineage 不完整、privacy/consent unknown 与 judge-calibration 空白的阻断。

该 benchmark 也可作为构造参考：职业/任务 ideation、人工任务实现、checkpoint 设计、evaluator 测试、环境封装、模拟同事和版本化 run submission 共同形成多服务 agent evaluation 的具体 recipe。更完善的复现应从一开始记录 task-source lineage、brainstorming prompt、review decision、image digest、service version、evaluator test、judge calibration 及被拒/失败 artifact，这些项目在当前发布中仍不完整。

安全复用等级是仅限 evaluation 与 audit，并且需要显式固定版本和审查权利。它适合比较智能体、研究环境反馈、压力测试 verifier 与设计更完整的 release manifest；目前不能安全地把 trajectory 仓库称为通用许可训练语料，benchmark 分数也不能作为数据质量或职业自动化的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the publication timeline explicit: arXiv v1 appeared on 2024-12-18, benchmark release 1.0.0 followed on 2024-12-20, and the archival venue is NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track.
  • Do not turn 24.0% into 30.3% into a controlled improvement claim. The former is OpenHands 0.14.2 + Claude-3.5-Sonnet; the latter is OpenHands 0.28.1 + Gemini 2.5 Pro, so model, harness, and paper version all drifted.
  • Read the task/evaluator description together with the official experiment run shape: one task has intent, checkpoints, evaluator, setup, and environment, while one run adds model-generated actions/observations, screenshots, checkpoint results, and a terminal outcome.
  • Remember that 51/175 tasks (29%) use LLM evaluation and 41 tasks use simulated colleagues. These model-mediated components are part of the measurement environment and need versioning and calibration.
  • Reuse only for version-pinned evaluation/audit until the experiment-log license, immutable images/manifests, split, decontamination, task-level lineage, judge variance, privacy/consent, and historical failure completeness are resolved; the logs are not an evidenced training corpus.

• 必须明确时间线：arXiv v1 于 2024 年 12 月 18 日公开，benchmark release 1.0.0 于 2024 年 12 月 20 日发布，正式 venue 则是 NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track。
  • 不要把 24.0% 到 30.3% 写成受控提升。前者使用 OpenHands 0.14.2 + Claude-3.5-Sonnet，后者使用 OpenHands 0.28.1 + Gemini 2.5 Pro，模型、harness 与论文版本都发生了漂移。
  • 应把 task/evaluator 描述与官方 experiment run 结构对照阅读：一条 task 包含意图、checkpoint、evaluator、setup 与环境；一次 run 再加入模型生成 action/observation、截图、checkpoint 结果与终态。
  • 记住 51/175 个任务（29%）使用 LLM evaluation，41 个任务使用模拟同事。这些模型驱动组件属于测量环境的一部分，需要版本化与校准。
  • 在 experiment-log license、不可变 image/manifest、split、去污染、任务级 lineage、judge 方差、privacy/consent 与历史失败记录完整性解决前，只能用于固定版本的 evaluation/audit；这些日志不是已有证据支持的训练语料。

value.html: Claude-3-5-Sonnet-20241022 for simulated colleagues and LLM-based evaluators in the paper baselines.

value_zh.html: 论文基线中模拟同事与基于 LLM 的评测器使用 Claude-3-5-Sonnet-20241022。

value.html: Twenty CS students, software engineers, and project managers over two months, about 3,000 person-hours; some tasks required more than ten hours.

value_zh.html: 二十名计算机科学学生、软件工程师与项目经理历时两个月，约 3,000 人时；部分任务需要超过十小时。

value.html: Task prompts combine O*NET/labor-market motivation, contributor expertise, undisclosed LLM brainstorming, manual implementation, manually curated mock-company material, and real-world software-project data. Released episodes come from evaluated models and harnesses.

value_zh.html: 任务提示结合 O*NET/劳动力市场动机、贡献者专长、未披露的 LLM 头脑风暴、人工实现、人工策展的模拟公司材料与真实世界软件项目数据。已发布 episodes 来自被评测模型与 harnesses。

value.html: No train/validation/test partition is disclosed; version 1.0.0 is presented as one 175-task evaluation set.

value_zh.html: 未披露 train/validation/test 划分；version 1.0.0 呈现为一个 175 任务评测集。

value.html: The paper compares with existing agent benchmarks, but no systematic prompt/code overlap or model-pretraining contamination audit is disclosed. Public prompts and evaluator sources create future benchmark-exposure risk.

value_zh.html: 论文与现有智能体基准比较，但未披露系统性提示/代码重叠或模型预训练污染审计。公开提示与评测器源造成未来基准暴露风险。

items: LLM-judged outputs can vary with evaluator-model behavior; no independent judge-calibration corpus is released.
Environment/evaluator predicates may reward unintended state changes or shortcuts.
Published task/evaluator source can enable benchmark-specific gaming or contamination despite runtime evaluator encryption.
Forty-one tasks use model-simulated colleagues; the paper reports repairing an earlier ambiguous role-play behavior.
Service images, backups, NPC models, and judge models are additional reproducibility dependencies beyond task code.
LLM 评审的输出可随评测器模型行为变化；未发布独立评审校准语料。
环境/评测器谓词可能奖励非预期状态变更或捷径。
已发布的任务/评测器源即使有运行时评测器加密，仍可能造成基准特定博弈或污染。
四十一项任务使用模型模拟同事；论文报告修复了更早的歧义角色扮演行为。
服务镜像、备份、NPC 模型与评审模型是任务代码之外的额外可复现性依赖。

value.html: Benchmark release 1.0.0 was published 2024-12-20. Paper results span arXiv v1 (2024) through archival NeurIPS 2025, while the experiments repository is a living leaderboard and should be pinned by commit/run path.
